Application Materials.content:
An incomplete application cannot be processed promptly and will reduce your chance of admission. Please complete all relevant fields on the application form and upload all necessary documents.
Additional Documents Required:
- Transcript / Certificate: Copies of certificates and academic transcripts are required.
- Others: Copies of all relevant professional qualifications, e.g. membership(s) of the HKICPA, AICPA, ACCA, CPA Australia, etc (if any).

Interview Requirements.content: Suitable candidates may be invited for interviews. If an applicant wishes to be considered for the entry scholarship, please submit an application for the entry scholarship upon invitation to an admission interview.

Academic Requirements.content:
- **A Bachelor’s degree**.
- Preference will be given to applicants with **a business degree**, who are equipped with some fundamental training in computing, or graduates with **a background in computing, science or engineering**.
- Interested applicants with **little or no working experience are encouraged to apply**.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
**English Language Requirement**: If you are not a native speaker of English, and your Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification is awarded by institutions where the medium of instruction is not English, you are expected to provide one of the following proficiency test results **taken in a single sitting within 2 years** for fulfil the minimum English language requirement for admission purpose:
- **TOEFL Internet-based test: 80 or above**; OR
- **IELTS Academic module: Overall Band score of 6.0 or above**.
Remarks: TOEFL iBT Home Edition, the IELTS Online, IELTS indicator test, and IELTS one skill retake results will not be considered for meeting the English language Requirements for taught programmes.

Program Overview.content:
MSc in Accounting and Finance Analytics
- Programme Code: 21052; Stream Code: FAM (Full-time), PAM (Part-time).
- Mode of Study: Mixed Mode. Students can pursue their studies with either a full-time study load (taking 9 credits or more in a semester) or a part-time study load (fewer than 9 credits in a semester).
- Normal Duration: 1 year (Full-time), 2 years (Part-time). Students should complete the programme full-time in 1 year and part-time in 2 years within the normal duration. Students will be required to attend more classes in the evening if they choose the full-time option, and the duration will be subject to class quota availability.
- Credits Required for Graduation: 31.
- Programme Director: Prof. Feng TIAN, PhD. Deputy Programme Director: Dr Justin LAW, PhD.
The advancement of information technology has made a great impact on the way of doing business and the practices in the accounting and finance profession. At the same time, the applications of data analytics have become increasingly important and significantly affected almost every business sector and industry. With the widespread application of emerging new digital technology to the accounting and finance profession, there is a need to equip students with the training of technological skills and knowledge to cope with the demands of the business community.
The **Master of Science in Accounting and Finance Analytics** is a conversion programme designed for graduates to develop a broad understanding of the accounting and finance disciplines and the applications of technology to these disciplines. The programme has been accepted into the CFA Institute University Affiliation Programme, positioning students to sit for the CFA examinations.
The programme aims to provide students with a combination of core knowledge in accounting and finance and skills in applying data analytics and technology to related practices. It facilities practitioners in accounting and finance to keep up with the latest data analytics applications and skills. The programme emphasizes:
1. Knowledge and skills in data analytics.
2. Core knowledge in accounting and finance.
3. Applications of data analytics in accounting and finance.
4. Systematic training and development of data analytics skills and capability in solving business problems in accounting and finance.
5. Capitalizing on opportunities offered by big data in solving accounting, finance and business problems.
Alumni describe the programme as helping them learn the latest data analytic skills, including python programming and machine learning, improve quantitative analytic skills in accounting and finance fields, develop combined knowledge in accounting, finance, data analytics and Python programming, and prepare for the job market. One alumnus noted that, with the expertise of world-class faculty and leading practitioners, the programme provided systematic training, knowledge and insights including analysis, programming, valuation, and information system.

Students can pursue their studies with either a full-time study load (taking 9 credits or more in a semester) or a part-time study load (taking less than 9 credits in a semester). Students will be required to attend more classes in the evening if they choose the full-time option and the duration of study will be subject to class quota availability.

Financial Aid.content:
**Scholarships**
Both entry scholarships and merit scholarships are provided. If an applicant wishes to be considered for the entry scholarship, please submit an application for the entry scholarship upon our invitation to an admission interview.
_PolyU reserves the right to change or withdraw the scholarship at any time. In case of any dispute/disagreement, PolyU’s decision is final._

Multiple Applications.content:
Multiple applications are allowed for applicants seeking admission to taught postgraduate programmes. You can make another application under the same account after you have submitted one application.
You are not allowed to change your programme choice after your application has been submitted. However, you may submit another application under the same account after you have submitted one application.
The application fee for admission to taught postgraduate programmes for 2026/27 is **HK$500**, except for Master of Business Administration (MBA) and doctorate programmes of Faculty of Business. The fee is non-refundable and non-transferrable. You must settle the application fee upon submission of your online application, otherwise, your application will not be further processed.
If you want to accept another offer from PolyU after paying the tuition fees for an earlier offer, please [contact us](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/study/pg/enquiry) to transfer the fees already paid for the earlier offer to the other offer. Please remember to provide application number of both offers in your request. This arrangement only applies if both programmes lead to PolyU awards.
Students are not allowed to enrol concurrently on two full-time/sandwich programmes whether or not one of the programmes is offered by another institution. Except for programmes which do not lead to any formal award, students are not allowed to enrol concurrently on a full-time/sandwich programme and a part-time programme, or more than one part-time programmes, including those offered by another institution without any approval from the Head of your academic Department.

Conditional Admission Policy.content:
If you are given an offer or a conditional offer, you will be informed via email/SMS. To accept an offer or a conditional offer, indicate your acceptance and settle the registration fee or tuition fee before the **“last day for payment”** displayed in the Notice of Offer, and register on the programme registration date indicated on the Notice of Offer. For a conditional offer, you need to complete the procedures for meeting the conditions stated in the Notice of Offer beforehand.
For meeting condition(s), return to the Online Notice of Offer page via eAdmission to complete the procedures for **“Meeting Conditions”** when you have acquired the relevant qualifications on or before the **“Meet Condition Date”**.
If you have not yet received your results/transcript(s)/certificate(s) when you apply, indicate in your application the date on which they will be available. You should update your results and upload your final official transcript(s)/certificate(s) to your application on or before the date specified.
If you are given a conditional offer, you will only receive the email notification on how to download your e-Visa after you have met the condition(s) of your admission offer.
